section_header: SERVICE SPECIFICATIONS — Cooling System, Lubrication System
ocr_text:
COOLING SYSTEM
Specifications

Engine coolant capacity                                    See page A-2
Thermostat        Valve opening temperature                86 – 90°C        187 – 194°F
                  Valve lift at 100°C (212°F)              8 mm (0.31 in.) or more
Radiator          Relief valve opening pressure      STD   0.75 – 1.05 kg/cm²
                                                           (11 – 15 psi, 74 – 103 kPa)
                                                     Limit  0.6 kg/cm²      8.5 psi      59 kPa


Torque Specifications

Part tightened                                           kg·cm           ft·lb          N·m
Drain plug                                               350             25             34
Water outlet × Water outlet housing                      80              69 in.·lb      7.8
Water pump × Cylinder block              10 mm           90              78 in.·lb      8.8
                                         12 mm           195             14             20


LUBRICATION SYSTEM
Specifications

Engine oil capacity                                      See page A-35
Oil pressure      at Idle speed                          0.3 kg/cm² (4.3 psi, 29 kPa) or more
                  at 3,000 rpm                           2.5 – 5.0 kg/cm    36 – 71 psi  245–490 kPa
Oil pump          Body clearance                   STD   0.105 – 0.175 mm              0.0041 – 0.0069 in.
                                                   Limit  0.2 mm                        0.008 in.
                  Side clearance                   STD   0.03 – 0.09 mm    0.0012 – 0.0035 in.
                                                   Limit  0.15 mm                       0.0059 in.
                  Gear backlash                    STD   0.5 – 0.8 mm      0.020 – 0.024 in.
                                                   Limit  0.9 mm                        0.035 in.
                  Relief valve operating pressure        4.4 – 5.0 kg/cm²  63 – 71 psi   431–490 kPa


Torque Specifications

Part tightened                                           kg·cm           ft·lb          N·m
Engine oil drain plug                                    350             25             34
Oil pump cover × Oil pump body                           75              65 in.·lb      7.4
Relief valve × Oil pump cover                            375             27             37
Oil pump × Cylinder block                                220             16             22
Oil pump strainer × Oil pump body                        130             9              13
Oil pump outlet pipe × Oil pump                          350             25             34
Oil pump outlet pipe × Union                             350             25             34
Oil pan × Cylinder block                                 130             9              13
Oil pressure regulator plug                              375             27             37
Oil filter bracket × Cylinder block                      500             36             49
